items.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
items.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint ventures proposed tokenized stock platform under the SECs innovation exemption.

items.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
items.summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

items.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
items.summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

items.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
items.summary: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

items.title: Hong Kongs Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
items.summary: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows as $636 million in withdrawals erase previous days inflows
items.summary: BlackRock's IBIT led Thursday's net outflows with $254.1 million.
